name: 3d-animation-short-generator
title_zh: 从一句话故事到成片动画，中间十道工序它替你排队
tagline_zh: 不用会建模、不用懂运镜，把故事梗概丢进去，它按分镜表逐镜生成再自动拼接配乐。
tagline_en: No modeling or camera skills needed. Drop a premise, it storyboards, generates shot-by-shot, assembles with BGM.
desc_en: Create complete stylized 3D animated shorts from a story idea through an ordered production workflow covering project brief, story outline, character and environment cards, standardized shot planning, text or optional pencil storyboards, video-model selection, single-shot generation, assembly, BGM matching, and final review. Use when the user wants an end-to-end narrative animation workflow with s
why_zh: 不是一键出片，而是把专业动画流程固化成有序流水线：先定调性再写卡，分镜表统一规格。
why_en: Not a one-click black box. It enforces a real production order—brief, cards, shot list, generation, assembly—so you can inspect.
limit_zh: 只产出 stylized 3D 短片，不覆盖写实或 2D 手绘；需要 MiniMax 视频模型 API 可用。
limit_en: Stylized 3D only—no photoreal or 2D. Requires MiniMax video API access. Text storyboards skip visual preview; pencil boards need your own drawing.
title_en: One-line story to finished 3D short, 10 ordered steps inside
